TITLE: XGBoost Native Error Strata
HEADING: XGBoost native error strata
INTRO:
Mean signed error and its standard deviation for all 48 native XGBoost probes, in 221 fine bins of sequence separation and final structure distance, with shared OLS on the same proteins for comparison.

All values are real out-of-fold predictions for 153 CAMEO proteins, excluding 7stz_C. Each probe is evaluated on its own layer. The 398 ECOD proteins are left out because their final structures are currently unavailable, so these values do not match the 551-protein OLS page. Signed error is the probe's distance minus the distance in OpenFold's final predicted structure. Red means the probe reads short of that structure, and it says nothing about agreement with experimental structures. SD is the spread across pairs in a bin, not a confidence interval.

Job 23618658. Fine bins reproduce 7,392 of 7,392 stored protein-layer rows and 81,312 of 81,312 published per-protein subgroup rows (3e-13 Å).
FINDINGS:
• XGBoost has lower error than OLS almost everywhere. Pooled MAE is 6.81 Å at layer 0, 2.88 Å at layer 22 and 1.29 Å at layer 47, against 7.56, 3.62 and 2.16 Å for OLS. At layer 47 it has the lower error in 139 of 141 well-supported bins.
  • OLS is better only in a narrow distance band. Those bins all fall between 25 and 60 Å: 19 bins at layer 0, 6 at layer 22 and 2 at layer 47.
  • XGBoost still reads short of long distances at every layer, by less than OLS. Pairs beyond 100 Å pool to −55 Å at layer 0, −38 Å at layer 22 and −23 Å at layer 47, against −66, −49 and −37 Å for OLS.
  • The 60–100 Å shortfall nearly closes by layer 47. It pools to −1.6 Å, against −7.2 Å for OLS.
  • The 6–7 Å stripe seen with OLS does not appear. At layer 47 and separation 7 or more, XGBoost reads +0.2 Å where OLS reads −1.0 Å. A weaker 4–5 Å stripe remains, at +0.7 Å against +1.7 Å.
  • Mid-range distances are close to unbiased, with a tight spread. At layer 47, 8–40 Å pools to +0.1 Å with SDs of 0.6 to 2.5 Å, while well-supported bins at 60 Å and beyond have SDs of 5.4 to 12.2 Å.

The well-supported bins beyond 100 Å rest on few proteins: 6 to 18 of 153, depending on sequence separation.
MEAN_ALT: Forty-eight small heatmaps of mean signed error for the XGBoost probes, one per layer, showing the probes reading short at long distances at every layer.
